prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent smoke particle brush for an animated hand-painted fantasy RPG cauldron at small scale. Primary request: a single wispy soft grey smoke puff with a loose upward curling shape, airy ragged feathered edges and a few translucent internal filaments. Pale cool grey highlights and warm medium grey shadows, delicate painted shading. Isolated centered, fills about 75 percent of a square, generous fully transparent margin on every side. This is SMOKE ONLY, no pot, no fire, no objects, no floor, no lettering. Genuinely transparent alpha background, low-density semi-transparent smoke, no rectangular haze or backdrop. Avoid hard outlines, opaque white cartoon clouds, dense black smoke, and solid background. It will be layered as many rising fading puffs above a painted cauldron.
